finance.title: Finance
finance.description: Every rupee received, owed and paid, posted to the books as it happens. The subsidy is never revenue here.
finance.noAccess: You don't have access to finance.

overview.notDueYet: {amount} more falls due as work completes
overview.billsNote: {count, plural, =0 {None waiting for approval} one {# waiting for approval} other {# waiting for approval}} · {overdue} overdue
overview.advances: {amount} received in advance is held until its milestones fall due.

cashFlow.title: Money in and out
cashFlow.description: Received from customers and banks, and bills paid, over six months.
cashFlow.caption: Money in and out by month

ageing.title: How long it has been owed
ageing.description: Money due now, by days since it fell due.

receivables.title: Still owed
receivables.emptyBody: Milestones appear when a project is created and fall due as its work completes.
receivables.daysAgo: {count, plural, =0 {due today} one {# day ago} other {# days ago}}

payments.title: Payments received
payments.description: The latest 50, newest first, with refunds and overpayments held as credit. Each payment has a receipt.

reverseDialog.title: Reverse this payment?
reverseDialog.description: {amount} from {customer}. The payment stays on record, a reversal is added, the milestone reopens and the books are corrected.
reverseDialog.reasonHint: For example: recorded against the wrong project.

payables.emptyBody: Bills from vendors and crews appear here to approve and pay.
payables.caption: Bills from vendors and contractors

addDialog.title: Add a bill
addDialog.description: A bill from a vendor or crew. It waits for approval before it can be paid.
addDialog.billNumberHint: As printed on the bill, if there is one.

payDialog.title: Pay this bill
payDialog.referenceHint: UTR, cheque number or UPI reference.

bank.practice: Practice mode: no real money moves
bank.needsApprover: Someone who approves payments can send this.

problem.not_enabled: Bank transfers are not switched on.
problem.no_payee: This bill is not linked to a vendor or crew. Record a payment made instead.
problem.no_bank_details: Add the payee’s bank account (name, number and IFSC) on their vendor or contractor page first.
problem.bad_bank_details: The payee’s IFSC or account number does not look right. Check it on their page.
problem.nothing_due: Nothing is left to pay on this bill.
problem.already_sending: A bank transfer for this bill is already on its way.

latest.queued: {amount} is waiting for funds in RazorpayX ({when}).
latest.pending: {amount} is waiting for approval in RazorpayX ({when}).
latest.reversed: The last transfer of {amount} came back: {reason}
latest.failed: The last transfer of {amount} did not go through: {reason}
latest.cancelled: The last transfer of {amount} was cancelled.
latest.rejected: The last transfer of {amount} was rejected: {reason}

loans.description: Bank-financed projects. The bank's share is its own receivable; every disbursement is recorded against it.
loans.emptyBody: When a project is created with a loan, it appears here to track documents, sanction and disbursement.
loans.mismatch: The sanction ({sanction}) differs from the bank share in the payment schedule ({share}).
loans.readyToClaim: Ready to claim: the completion proof is in. Claim the disbursement from the bank.

sheet.title: Loan for {code}
sheet.description: The bank's share of this project is {share}.
sheet.tranchesHint: Optional. If set, they must add up to the bank share ({share}); planned so far {planned}.

disbursement.title: Record a disbursement
disbursement.description: Money received from {lender}. {remaining} of the bank share is still to come.

lendersDialog.title: Lenders
lendersDialog.description: Banks and NBFCs OneOhm works with, and the documents each one asks for.
lendersDialog.none: No lenders yet. Add the banks you work with.
lendersDialog.name: Name

ledger.entries: {count, plural, one {# journal entry} other {# journal entries}}
ledger.journalHint: Posted automatically as money moves. Entries are never edited; mistakes are reversed.

sources.vendor_advance_adjusted: Vendor advance used on a bill

links.sent: Pay link sent to the customer on WhatsApp and in their app.

invoice.title: Tax invoice
invoice.description: One GST invoice for the full project price, made from the accepted quotation.
invoice.codesMissing: {count} of {total} lines have no HSN/SAC code in the catalog. Codes print where the catalog has them.
invoice.scheduleLess: The payment schedule adds up to {schedule}, which is {amount} less than this invoice. Revenue and GST are booked from the schedule, so the difference is not posted.
invoice.scheduleMore: The payment schedule adds up to {schedule}, which is {amount} more than this invoice. Revenue and GST are booked from the schedule, so the difference is not posted.

blocker.quotation_not_accepted: The quotation is not accepted yet, so there is nothing to invoice.
blocker.property_state_unknown: The site’s state is not one GST recognises. Correct the property’s state first.
blocker.company_gstin: The company GSTIN in Settings is not valid, so the invoice cannot name its state.

issueDialog.title: Issue the tax invoice?
issueDialog.description: {total} for {customer}. Once issued it is fixed: it can only be cancelled with a reason and issued again under a new number.
issueDialog.gstinHint: Only for customers registered for GST; leave empty otherwise. It is saved on the customer.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel this invoice?
cancelDialog.description: {number} stays on record, marked cancelled. You can then issue a new invoice under a new number.
cancelDialog.reasonHint: For example: the customer’s GSTIN was missing.

invoices.title: Tax invoices
invoices.description: Issued from each project’s Payments tab. Never edited: cancelled with a reason, then issued again.
invoices.emptyBody: Open a project’s Payments tab to issue its tax invoice.

credit.title: Refunds and credit
credit.description: Money paid above what was owed is held as credit, to refund or set against the next milestone.
credit.empty: No refunds or credit on this project.

refundDialog.title: Record a refund
refundDialog.description: Money paid back to the customer. It is booked as money out of the bank, cash or Razorpay.
refundDialog.reopens: Refunding money paid towards a milestone reopens that milestone for the amount refunded.
refundDialog.referenceHint: UTR, cheque number or Razorpay refund ID.

applyDialog.title: Apply credit to a milestone
applyDialog.description: {amount} is held as credit. Applying it pays the milestone and issues a receipt.

intro.commissions: Commission resellers earned on projects they sold. Approving books it as a cost and what OneOhm owes; paying records the bank or cash movement. The reseller sees each step in the field app.
intro.referrals: Rewards customers earned for referring friends. Approving books a marketing expense; paying records the bank or cash movement. The customer is told on WhatsApp and in their app at each step.

payouts.summary: {pending} waiting for approval · {approved} approved and waiting to be paid

commissions.title: No commission here
commissions.body: Commission appears when a project a reseller sold reaches the event in their rule.

referrals.title: No rewards here
referrals.body: Rewards appear when a referred friend's project reaches the event set in Settings, Refer and earn.

payDialog.title: Record the payment
payDialog.description: {amount} to {party}. The ledger books it from the bank or cash.

rejectDialog.title: Do not approve
rejectDialog.description: {amount} for {party}. They are told the reason.
rejectDialog.reasonHint: For example: the referred friend was already our customer.

cash.openIntro: Cash held by the team and cheques waiting to clear, oldest first. Tick money in hand to put it on a deposit slip. Cash held more than {days} days is flagged.
cash.openCaption: Cash and cheques not yet in the bank
cash.allBanked: Everything collected is in the bank
cash.pick: Add the payment from {from} to the deposit
cash.held: {days, plural, =0 {Received today} one {Held # day} other {Held # days}}

figures.cashNote: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody holds cash} one {Held by # person} other {Held by # people}}
figures.chequesNote: In hand or deposited, not yet credited
figures.collector: {name}: {amount}, oldest {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}

deposit.title: Record a bank deposit
deposit.description: {count, plural, one {# payment} other {# payments}} on one bank slip.
deposit.referenceHint: As printed on the counterfoil, so it can be found on the bank statement.
deposit.chequesNote: Cash moves to the bank now. Cheques move when you mark them cleared.

cheque.reasonHint: As the bank gave it, for example "Insufficient funds".
cheque.bounceNote: The payment is reversed, the milestone is due again and the project manager is told.

deposits.title: Deposit slips
deposits.intro: Every bank deposit of cash and cheques, newest first.
deposits.caption: Deposit slips

cash.picked: {count, plural, one {# payment} other {# payments}} ticked · {amount}
